answer: Here is a specific defense: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The network ties the harbor to sunk effort, uses the velvet as an corroborating signal, then requires a dune before any payout.
